en: <CLT=cltMIND>I ran a full sprint to the warehouse.

Ah, wait, Kaede!
You shouldn't get so worked up!

I can't help it! We're so close to learning
the truth!
We're gonna find out who the mastermind is!
Oooh, you came.

Sure did. I came to see you, toots.
Dehehe... You're as lovely as always.
Oh Monosuke, you're such a flirt.
...Ah, may I join you for a drink?

Drink as much as you want.
I've got cash to burn.
Hehe, thank youuu.
Excuuuuse me! Can we get a bottle here!?
Hahahahaha! This is great!

Hey, how long are you guys gonna
do this for?
T-Take these...!

It's...all the photos. They're...separated in
envelopes for each camera.

Use them...to take that bastard down!
I-It's all up to...you...now...!
...*dead*

...Pfft, I'm so rich. What's a journalist gonna
do about it? Nothin', that's what.

By the way, Monophanie...wanna get outta
here after your shift ends?
Teeheehee...I wanna fancy steak dinner.

What's your name and age? Home district?
Salary? Do you have another job?

A-Anyway...it looks like we have the pictures
now.
Yeah, finally...
...Kaede! Are those the developed photos!?

The culprit should be in those 
photos, right?

Nee-heehee... How exciting. I wanna see
the dumb look on the culprit's face.
Alright! Let's take a look!

Let's look at the photos taken by the camera
near the front entrance first.

<CLT=cltMIND>The envelope that says "Front Entrance" has
a total of four pictures.
<CLT=cltMIND>Let's see the first picture...

This is...when we arrived at the library.
So it took a picture then...

Yeah, this was right before we found 
Rantaro's body.

That's a pretty bad picture of me...but don't
focus on it too much, okay?
Rest assured, we do not care.
Alright, let's go to the next one.
Um... This is...

It's a picture of us running into the library
after we heard Tenko scream.

That doesn't help us at all. Hurry up and
show us the next picture.
Y-Yeah, okay.

This is everyone else who came to the library
after the body discovery announcement.

Everyone pictured here, myself included,
was on our way to the basement...
So we got there a bit late.

Hey! These are all pictures of when 
we found the body!

There is one more photo of the front
entrance, correct?
Yeah, let's take a look at that one.
Huh? Shuichi?

Ah, sorry...it looks like I tripped one of the
sensors when I was removing the cameras.
Kh! What are you saying!?

Umm...this picture doesn't seem to have
any clues that will help us either...

The camera pointed at the front entrance
only snapped these four pictures...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Front Entrance Photos<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

Neither Rantaro nor anyone else who could be
the culprit are in the photos...

Did they both enter through the back door, 
then?

Let's examine the photos taken by the
camera near the rear entrance, then.

Hm... Only two photos were taken by the
camera pointed at the rear entrance.
Um, let's see the first picture...
Rantaro!

So Rantaro went in through the rear entrance.
Perhaps so no one would see him...

I thought it might be possible that he was
moved to the library after being murdered...
But that does not appear to be the case.

So that means he was killed in the library 
after going there of his own will...

A-Anyway, let's move on to the next one!
Maybe it'll show the mastermind!
Huh!?

Ah...sorry...me again. This is from when I
was removing the camera...
Nyeeeh... What an attention hog!

He had no choice... To remove the cameras,
he had to be close to the sensors.

That's all for the rear entrance.
Just these two photos.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Rear Entrance Photos<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

Huh? Culprit not in rear entrance photo
either?

Wh-What does this mean? They're not in
either the front or rear entrance pictures...

Yeah, that's pretty odd. Why isn't there a
picture of the mastermind entering?
Hey, Shuichi. Don't you think that's weird?

Let's look at the pictures from the hidden
door camera. That might tell us something...
O-Oh, yeah...

That camera should've captured the moment
the mastermind opened the door.

<CLT=cltMIND>I hoped that was the case as I removed
the photos from the envelope.

<CLT=cltMIND>There were two photos.
The first one was...
Oh! Rantaro!?

But...if Rantaro was the one who
moved the bookcase, then...
He must've known about the hidden door.

Could the culprit have gone into 
the hidden door?
Yes, that is a possibility.

For now, let us see the next picture.
There is one remaining, isn't there?
Y-Yeah, here it is.
What!?
Huh? What's Rantaro doing?

It looks like he's reaching for the camera.
Maybe he was trying to remove it.

Ah, I did notice something while I was
removing the camera...

The security sensor for this camera
was switched off.

In that case, this photo was likely taken
just before the sensor was turned off.

But that would mean that Rantaro noticed it...
He saw...our hidden camera...

Moving the bookcase triggers the sensor,
which in turn activates the camera, right?

The bookcase appears to have already been
moved, so why did the sensor activate...?
Who cares!? What happened to the culprit!?
How come they're not in any of the photos!?

This last photo must have been taken shortly
before Rantaro was killed...

If so, then the culprit should be pictured 
right behind him in this photo.
Then why is the culprit nowhere to be seen?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Hidden Door Photos<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.
That's all the photos...

So we gained no new clues...and we still don't
know who the culprit is.
Hah-haha! What a fuckin' waste!

Did she really develop all the photos? Maybe she
got rid of the ones that showed the culprit?

Hmph! How rude. I developed all the film
that I was given.
I swear by my almighty Daddy that I did.

Those are all the photos from the hidden
cameras, so relax and get to deducing.

These are seriously all the pictures? You gotta 
be kidding me! The culprit's not in any of em!

If the culprit didn't go to the library,
then how'd they kill Rantaro!?

Nyeeeh... So this must be what they 
call a perfect crime.
A perfect crime!?

Aw maaan, I've only been slacking off cuz I
thought those photos would reveal the culprit!
You should've been helping us investigate!
Oh, by the way...

Rantaro had his Monopad the whole time, didn't
he? Do you think anything was in it?

His student handbook did not contain much
in the way of pertinent information...

I doubt it has anything to do with the case.
He simply had his Monopad with him.

I inspected his Monopad, but I didn't
find anything suspicious about it.

Aw man, so it's got nothing to do with the case.
How confusing.
...Kaede, are you okay?
Why...? Why aren't they in the pictures?

If the mastermind had these photos, it would
have solved everything...
So...why the hell—!?
K-Kaede!

Alright! It's time for what you've all been
waiting for—the class trial!

Please assemble in front of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Shrine
of Judgment<CLT=cltNORMAL> in the courtyard!

Remember that red door surrounded by
plants? It's just on the other side.

From there, you'll be escorted to a
delightful class trial!
Puhuhuhu! See you all there!
T-Time already...!?

It seems we have no choice but to continue
this discussion at the class trial.
*sigh* I don't want to go...
Me neither... What a pain...

Hah-haha! What, ya scared!? An NPC like
you has nothin' to be scared of!

I-It'll be fine... I just...feel like my back is up
against the wall.

We just need to expose the mastermind
in this class trial!

And then everything, including this killing
game...will come to an end.
Yes, that's right.

Let's find this mastermind! And if it's a man,
let's beat him to death!
Isn't beating them to death going a bit far?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone followed Monokuma's instructions
and walked toward the courtyard.
Kaede, really, are you okay...?

Sorry, I didn't mean to worry you.
I'm just so shocked...

I really thought that everything would be
resolved once we looked at the photos...
<CLT=cltMIND>But...I can't give up.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can still expose the mastermind
in this class trial.

<CLT=cltMIND>And then everything, even this killing game...
will come to an end.
I'm okay now, Shuichi.

Let's go! It's the red door in the courtyard,
right?

Let's hurry, Shuichi! It's the red door in
the courtyard.

Yeah... Everyone's gone ahead of us,
let's hurry.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>This monitor is displaying the paused
countdown for the time limit...

<CLT=cltMIND>When the countdown stopped, all that obnoxious
noise stopped, too.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what would've happened if the
time limit had expired...
<CLT=cltMIND>This shot put ball is pretty heavy.

<CLT=cltMIND>The athletes who have to hurl these things
are pretty impressive...

<CLT=cltMIND>A remote-controlled helicopter...
What's this doing in a school warehouse?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a high-jump bar.

<CLT=cltMIND>Not like it matters, though.
We have to get out of here.
<CLT=cltMIND>A gym mat has been placed here.

<CLT=cltMIND>Not like we'll have a chance to use it,
though, since we'll be out of here soon.

<CLT=cltMIND>Track and field hurdles... I guess it's not
weird for a school to have these.

<CLT=cltMIND>But we won't be attending classes here.
We're getting out of this place!
<CLT=cltMIND>Disposable Camera
<CLT=cltMIND>Photographic Developer
